text: Maestro Skills 是面向 DSH 的开发技能库，通过 Cordis 技能提供器扫描包内各技能目录，将 SKILL.md 的名称、描述和正文提供给 agent 按需调用。技能覆盖头脑风暴与需求澄清、测试驱动开发、系统化调试、计划执行和代码评审，也包含 Govard 开发环境、Magento 与 PHP 框架开发、性能审查、UI 设计及 Mermaid 图表制作指南。适合希望在 DSH 中复用结构化软件开发流程和框架知识的开发者；无需额外 API 密钥，按 README 可用 dsh plugin 命令安装。

Maestro Skills serves packaged SKILL.md guides through a DSH provider. It offers software workflow guidance such as brainstorming, TDD and debugging, plus Govard, Magento, PHP, UI design and diagram skills. Install as a DSH plugin; no extra API key is required.

@ddtcorex/maestro-skills README · Maestro Skills (`maestro-skills`)：> **Works best with [Govard](https://github.com/ddtcorex/govard).** Most command examples in the domain skills assume a Govard-managed dev environment (`govard sh -c "..."`, `govard tool magerun ...`) — without it, you'll need to adapt them to your own container/CLI setup. One-line install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddtcorex/govard/master/install.sh | bash`.

@ddtcorex/maestro-skills README · 1. DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — as a plugin (recommended)：One command is a complete install — the plugin serves every packaged skill itself:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ddtcorex/maestro-skills
```

Then restart `dsh web`. No install.sh needed.

@ddtcorex/maestro-skills README · 1. DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — as a plugin (recommended)：**The agent preset is a separate, explicit step.** Skills and presets are two different
mechanisms: the plugin registers a skill provider, but a preset is an
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` **declaration row** that some bundle has to carry. To get
**"Maestro Skills"** in the Web GUI agent picker, copy the two files from this package's
`.dsh-plugin/` into a `dsh-agent-preset` row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

@ddtcorex/maestro-skills README · 1. DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — as a plugin (recommended)：```yaml
- insert:
    - id: preset-maestro-skills
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:

> This plugin used to copy that directory into `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/maestro-skills/` on
> every boot and log that the preset was installed. DSH stopped reading that directory when
> presets became declaration rows (2026-09-22) — the write changed nothing and the log
> misled. The template still ships in `.dsh-plugin/` because declaration rows are copied
> from it by hand.

@ddtcorex/maestro-skills README · 1. DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — as a plugin (recommended)：**Codex + Claude delegation preset (optional bundles, optional preset):** when the web
profile also installs the two optional subagent bundles (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`
and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code`), add a second declaration row for
**"Maestro Skills + Subagents (Codex + Claude)"** — the same composition with
`subagent_codex` and `subagent_claude_code` tool rows enabled, so the model can delegate to
those products through their official app-server/SDK result contract instead of whichever
CLI happens to be on `PATH`. `src/subagent-variant.ts` is the executable definition of that
derivation. Both providers authenticate via their native subscription login, so
quota-limited accounts may see provider-side quota errors until the limit resets.

@ddtcorex/maestro-skills README · 1. DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — as a plugin (recommended)：The package builds itself on install via its `prepare` script. pnpm ≥ 10 blocks git-dependency build scripts until you allow them — if the first add reports an ignored build, copy the key pnpm prints into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and re-run:
```yaml
allowBuilds:
  '@ddtcorex/maestro-skills': true
```

To reference the plugin from a hand-written patch layer instead, the row must name the real package:
```yaml
- insert:
    - id: maestro-skills
      name: '@ddtcorex/maestro-skills'
```

@ddtcorex/maestro-skills README · 1. DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — as a plugin (recommended)：> Do not link skills into `~/.dsh/skills/` (the old `install.sh --target dsh`
> path, removed): the preset-layer `skill-filesystem` provider would shadow
> the plugin with a stale cache. The plugin is the single source of truth
> on DSH.

@ddtcorex/maestro-skills README · 🔄 Superpowers fork maintenance：The process skills are an upstream fork, not hand-maintained copies:

```bash
scripts/sync-superpowers.sh            # latest upstream HEAD
scripts/sync-superpowers.sh v7.0.0     # a specific tag
```

The script prints a diff for review; the fork carries no content additions (its `PRESERVE` list is intentionally empty), and the fork-provenance note in `using-superpowers/SKILL.md` is re-applied by hand during review. Do not edit forked skill bodies by hand — see `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`.

text: @ddtcorex/maestro-skills README · Step 1: Create the Skill Folder：Create `skills/[framework/tool]-[purpose]/` using kebab-case (e.g., `skills/laravel-dev-core/`, `skills/vue-hyva-checkout/`). For *process* skills, don't create them here — contribute upstream to obra/superpowers instead.

@ddtcorex/maestro-skills README · Step 2: Create a `SKILL.md` File：Every skill folder **must** contain a `SKILL.md` file at its root with valid YAML frontmatter:

```markdown
---
name: your-skill-name
description: |
  Describe exactly when the AI Agent should trigger this skill.
compatibility: claude, codex, opencode, copilot, dsh
depends: [any-dependencies-if-applicable]
---
